race.comment: GREY BELIEF (11) is finding the breakthrough elusive but was too bad to be true last start at Dubbo. Her form prior lines up well for this however and she gets a good chance to finally break through if she brings her A-game. DENISE'S GAL (10) comes through the same race, where she showed good early dash and held on well to finish second. Expecting them to push forward again over this bigger distance. REDALUCA GIRL (12) is mixing her form but comes right into contention down in the weights with the benefit of the 3kg claim. Is another that backs up quickly and is in the mix. FORWARDING (1) is knocking on the door and doesn't need to improve much to get the verdict.
